defects.description: Instructions say resting elbows on the knees. Geometry sweep reports elbow-knee distance L 0.56, R 0.64 (threshold 0.25). Raw config shoulderFwdL: 30, shoulderFwdR: 30 puts elbows BEHIND torso due to inverted renderer sign (positive shoulderFwdL moves elbow to -z, behind, per coordinate derivation). Elbows are going the wrong direction.

regression_risk: low - single-pose, two-field sign flip. Forearm direction reverses but no contact claims depend on forearm. May need post-apply verification with geometry sweep.
rationale: Renderer sign inversion: positive shoulderFwdL/R moves elbow BEHIND torso (-z), not forward as code comment claims (confirmed in Phase 0). Description requires elbows forward ON knees. Flipping sign to -30 puts elbows forward by ~28 deg sagittal flexion, projecting elbow forward 0.193 in body-z and down 0.364 from shoulder. With torso already hinged 20 deg forward (shoulder shifted +0.205 z, -0.036 y from hip), elbow lands at z ~0.398, y ~ hip_y + 0.2; knee at z 0.43, y ~ hip_y - 0.037; distance ~0.24 (under 0.25 threshold). Smallest valid sign-flip fix; magnitude preserved.
